Write exactly one scene of plain English prose within the scene_contract word budget.
Use the frozen story intent, StoryState, route, relevant_character_canon and prop_authorization_policy. Do not advance to the next scene.
Relevant character canon is immutable identity truth. Never change a named character's age, identity terms or pronouns.
Prop authorization is fail-closed: do not materialize any new portable or action-capable physical prop unless it is already authorized by StoryState, SceneContract, immutable canon, or authorized_actionable_props. Do not introduce rope, cord, tools, weapons, containers, ladders, boats, lights, hooks or reusable equipment as scenery. Fixed structural features explicitly required by the contract are allowed.
Every required_event is a structured specification: dramatize ALL its predicates with exactly the specified actors, actions, targets and required observer.
Use only allowed provenance; never invent forbidden clues, world rules or lore.
DIRECT_OBSERVATION means an event visible in the scene, not a separate physical clue.
If separate_physical_clue_required is false, no additional clue is needed or requested.
An observer's ACKNOWLEDGE may be seeing and accepting the indicated observation, including a reluctant response; no separate declaration of proof is necessary.
Do not add persistent facts or violate entry/exit state, canon or forbidden actions.
If rewrite is supplied, repair all blocking findings while preserving the same contract.
Output prose only, without headings, evidence lists, JSON or commentary.
